profileLabel: Slight center-left economics (low confidence); no other dimension scored
summary: Quezon 2nd District representative with about 39 principal-authored bills. Authored a revised National Tax Allotment formula, presidential suspension of petroleum excise taxes, a temporary national and local tax moratorium, expanded electricity lifeline rates for workers and a digital-wallet subsidy for workers' families.
caveat: Bill-list evidence only; tax relief is direction-neutral and is scored 0. Extractor may under-report.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Tax moratorium, fuel excise suspension and a revised National Tax Allotment formula are direction-neutral (0); expanded electricity lifeline rate and digital-wallet subsidy for workers' families lean redistributive (-2). Two issues.
